title: Cold rebuild: group and inhibit
summary: Rebuild Alertmanager-style grouping and inhibition from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **Group and inhibit like Alertmanager** in *Alerts that page for the right reasons*. Write it again from an
**empty editor**. Why this one? When on-call says "I got 40 pages" or "I got none", the answer is almost always grouping or
inhibition; reasoning about it precisely is the skill.

steps.prompt: `group_by: [alertname]` only. 30 services fire `TargetDown`. How many notifications?
steps.explain: Grouping only by alertname puts every service in one message, which is often too coarse: add `service` (or `team`) so each owner gets their own.

steps.title: Rebuild Notify cold
prompt: Write `List<string> Notify(List<Alert> firing)` again: tickets inhibited by a page of the same service, groups by name and
service, `"[{SEVERITY}] {Name} {Service}: {n} firing ({sorted instances})"`, pages first, then by name and service.
`record Alert(string Name, string Service, string Severity, string Instance);` is given.
